scope: Real-source version discovery acceptance exposed a source document/image resource boundary regression. This is independent of the unresolved chapters19/20 cache/loading report.
root_cause: Venera findComicVersionsControlled fetches the gallery HTML through ordinary loadResourceControlled, whose runtime loadResource path resolves thumbnail/image hooks and requires an encoded-image signature.
A successful HTML response cannot produce an image-only native token. The current production bootstrap rejects the version document before adapter #gnd parsing.

Persisted relation projection and HomeVersionReuseLifecycle refresh fallback can keep the existing version panel visible after the fresh discovery fails; seeing stored versions is not evidence of a successful current source request.

failing_first.bootstrap_failure: Production __zicInvoke routes the document to http_image_binary, invokes a thumbnail hook and fails before returning the HTML payload.
